meta.note: Light values come from index.html; the dark theme, success/danger fills, on-* tokens and the darker mute are new in this design.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: ink, mute.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the study card front, box and deck rows, inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper and card; 1.5px borders; fill of primary buttons, box numbers and toasts.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, box number, toast).

tokens.name: on-ink-accent
tokens.usage: The action word inside a toast (Undo), on ink.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper and card: subtitles, hints, counts of empty boxes, the cog.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the borders of empty or inactive elements. Never text.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The yellow of a learned card: the study card's back, the number of a filled box 5.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text, border and icon on signal yellow, in both themes.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Progress ticks, the wordmark's dot, and the focus ring on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Fill of the I know it button. Only for that answer.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill of Not yet and of swipe-to-delete; text and border of Delete card on paper.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The app's name in the header, with its dot in deep.

styles.name: word
styles.usage: The word on the study card. Wraps; never truncated.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Box and deck names in rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Add your first word. It starts in box 1.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Tap a box to study it.
styles.usage: Help text under a screen, in mute.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Card counts on box and deck rows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: tally
styles.usage: Top bar: breadcrumb, position counter, learned tally. Uppercase.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Field labels and card hints. Uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The subtitle line inside a button. Uppercase, only when it adds information.

tokens.name: space-tick
tokens.usage: Gap between progress ticks in a box row.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row and between stacked rows; the cog's inset from the card corner.

tokens.name: space-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of box and deck rows and of buttons (vertical).

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter of every screen.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Padding inside the study card; gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner. vijf is square: cards, rows, buttons, inputs, toasts.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers in lists.

tokens.name: border-stroke
tokens.usage: The outline of cards, rows, buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, in deep, offset 2px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the app column on wide screens.

tokens.name: card-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the study card on phones.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target, e.g. the cog button inside the card.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: The cog icon.

tokens.name: swipe-reveal
tokens.usage: Width of the red Delete area revealed by swiping a deck row.
